note: Data-driven feature registry. default_checked accepts true, false, or "zh_system" (selected by default only when the system language is Chinese). Distribution policy: Chinese voice is not included (vo_zh is retained for internal use only); Chinese text is generated at install time rather than shipped as locres — the build exports the single source zh_lexicon.xlsx to app/zh_runtime.json, and installation rewrites four chains (locres / FlairName / asset_text / BFL) in place with a per-file backup. bonus_steam_ini is not implemented and not registered; CODEX and the Steam emulator are not bundled.

desc.zh: 界面、称号、战团标签全中文；安装时就地生成。
desc.en: Full Chinese UI, flair & chapter names, generated in place.

desc.zh: 已确认并实机验证的修复；完整清单见「Bug 详情」。
desc.en: Confirmed and player-verified fixes. See "Bug details" for the list.

desc.zh: 配置级画质增强，按显卡选一档（核显 / 独显 / 最高）；原版请用「还原到原版」。点卡查看各档参数。
desc.en: Config-level visual boost. Pick a tier for your GPU (Integrated / Discrete / Max); use Restore for vanilla. Click the card for parameters.

label.zh: 核显 · 集成显卡 / 低功耗
独显 · 适合 1050Ti 级独立显卡
最高 · 适合 4060 级主流显卡

desc.zh: 解除镜头高度 / 俯仰限制；勾选时会先给出使用提醒。
desc.en: Unlock camera height / pitch limits. A usage warning appears when selected.

warning.zh: 【谨慎】摄像机可能撞墙。当你找不到人物时：按住R（3 秒钟），然后再按 Tab 就能恢复。
warning.en: [Caution] The camera may clip into walls. If you can't find your marines: hold R for 3 seconds, then press Tab to recover.

desc.zh: 爱好者武器平衡调整（仅武器，不改战士/技能；默认不勾选，点卡查看说明）。
desc.en: Fan-made weapon balance tweaks (weapons only, no marine/skill changes; unchecked by default, click for details).

warning.zh:
注意：这是爱好者基于对游戏机制理解做的武器平衡调整，非官方改动。
具体调整方向见下方数值说明。仅等字节改数值、逐文件备份可回滚；不改动 exe 与启动校验组件。
warning.en:
Note: fan-made weapon balance tweaks based on a hobbyist understanding of the mechanics, not an official change.
See the numerical details below. Equal-byte numeric edits only, per-file backup and rollback; no exe or boot/DRM component is touched.

desc.zh: 为三件 T2 战团特色武器补充原版已有的授予技能与卡面图标；默认不勾选，点卡查看清单。
desc.en: Adds original-game weapon-granted skills and card icons to three T2 chapter weapons; unchecked by default, click for details.

warning.zh: 注意：这是爱好者基于原版已有武器技能做的调整，非官方改动。以整文件替换 6 个武器模板资产，逐文件备份可回滚；不改数值、不改 exe 与启动校验组件。
warning.en: Note: fan-made adjustments built from skills that already exist in the game, not an official change. Replaces six weapon-template assets in full, with per-file backup and rollback; no stat edits, no exe or boot/DRM component is touched.

desc.zh: 不随包分发、不下载；点击查看本地 DIY 提示词。
desc.en: Not shipped or downloaded. Click for a local DIY prompt.

desc.zh: 接收一名黑盾（可能是堕天使）加入你的守望要塞。
desc.en: A Black Shield (possibly a Fallen Angel) joins your fortress.

warning.zh: 注意：作用于你的存档。注入前会自动备份；但还原存档会丢失注入之后的游玩进度。
warning.en: Note: modifies your save. A backup is made first; restoring the save loses any progress made after injection.
